parts.text: In this experiment you are to determine the position of the centre of mass of a triangular card. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1 You are provided with a small mass attached to a length of thread. This is referred to as the plumbline.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Hang the card on the nail through hole A .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Hang the plumbline from the nail so that it is close to the card but not touching it.

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) When the card and plumbline are still, make a small mark at the edge of the card where the plumbline crosses the edge.

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Remove the card and draw a line from the mark to hole A .

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Repeat the steps in (b) using hole B .

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Repeat the steps in (b) using hole C .

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Place your card in the space below and draw around its outline. On your diagram on page 4,

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) show the positions of each of the holes A , B and C with a small, neat circle. Label each circle with the appropriate letter ( A , B or C ),

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) show the positions of each of the marks you made in (b)(iii) with a small neat cross ( ),

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) draw the lines between the positions of the holes A , B and C and the corresponding marks, as on your sheet of card. [5]

ms.label: 1(e)(iii)
ms.text: Lines cross at same point, within 5mm

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) If the experiment is completely accurate, the centre of mass of the card is at the position where the three lines meet. On your diagram judge the best position for the centre of mass. Draw a line from this position to the right-angled corner of the card and measure the distance a between the centre of mass and the right-angled corner of the card. a = ................................................. [3]

parts.label: g
parts.text: (g) In this experiment it is important that the card is able to swing freely. For this reason the plumbline should not touch the card, but be a small distance from the card. This could cause an inaccuracy in marking the card at the correct position (part (b)(iii) ). Describe how you minimised the possible inaccuracy. You may draw a diagram. .......................................................................................................................................... .....................................................................................................................................
